description: Block B1 — the fill experiment: one CPU-heavy agent (gsea_permutation, 314s execute) + one GPU-heavy agent (deseq_synthetic, 3.8% bubble). Agent 1 is staggered by 60s so it starts while agent 0 is deep in its long execute phase. Expected result: agent 0's GPU bubble fraction drops (GPU filled by agent 1's inference); agent 1's TTFT/TPOT stay near single-tenant baseline (no GPU collision). fill_fraction in session_summary should be high; gpu_collision_s low.
